views.markdown:
- Everything in the free Mikkyy: themed app icons on every surface, plus live Calendar and Clock icons
- Settings rows, tab bars, and the system symbols used throughout iOS
- Control Center modules and tiles, share sheet icons, switch and slider knobs, the phone keypad, and weather artwork
- Status bar battery, signal, and Wi-Fi artwork, still turning red when low and yellow in Low Power Mode
- In-app artwork for themes that dress the inside of an app (optional)
- Icon masks, corner radius, icon size, hide icon labels, hide touch overlays, prefer 3x artwork
- Themed icon badges, and icon effects — overlay, underlay, and shadow — on every Home Screen icon
- Built to stay fast, even with themes that carry thousands of images

Installing Mikkyy Pro replaces the free package and keeps your settings.

Existing SnowBoard themes can be used as they are.

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/MikkyyPro.html).

## 1.0.2 - 2026-09-02
- Data collection mode: for theme authors — writes every themeable image out as a ready-to-paint theme skeleton, in the same layout SnowBoard's collector uses.
- Calendar icon: the live Calendar icon's date text now supports size and position adjustment.
- Added compatibility for themes whose folder is named with a short bundle name.
- Themed glyphs are now sharper and rendered at the correct size.
- Fixed themed glyph colours across light and dark appearance.
- Fixed themed glyphs to fit correctly inside the stock symbol box.
- Improved status bar theming, including the battery.
- Fixed unintended theming of some Lock Screen glyphs.
- Improved theming of the Settings row icons and the share sheet icons.
- The Clock icon now receives icon effects and Custom Icon Size like the other icons.
- Improved small-icon scaling and icon drawing performance.

## 1.0.1 - 2026-08-22
- Icon badge support: a theme that ships badge artwork now replaces the red count bubble.
- Icon effect support: a theme's overlay, underlay, and shadow artwork is now drawn with every Home Screen icon.
- Fixed the dialler's call button not being themed.
- Added a compatibility layer for older themes that name their passcode art `<digit>Passcode`.
- Fixed a potential crash in status bar theming on dual-SIM devices.
- The theme folder is now created on install when it does not exist.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-21
- Initial release.
